SR-202608-0001 / req-1
Prepared for: TRSHARKS

Metal Drywall / Cavity Anchors — Target Buyers

Real demand-side buyers for TRSHARKS's metal cavity/hollow-wall anchors — Canada (primary), Europe, and recommended additional markets.

1011 buyers across 33 markets · Part 1 = recent buy-requests, Part 2 = scored importers/distributors

P1
Self-Drilling Winged Drywall Anchor (Jilet-Tip, 28 & 40 mm)
No-drill carbon-steel anchor: hammer the spike tip straight in and the wings expand behind the panel as the screw drives. Light-to-medium loads on drywall, plasterboard, hollow brick/block and hollow composite/wood panels. Fast and tool-light — curtain rails, shelves, hooks, TV brackets, mirrors.
P2
Spring Toggle / Umbrella Bolt (4x80)
Drill a hole, fold the spring wings, push through; the wings snap open behind the wall/ceiling and the machine bolt clamps the load across a wide area. Medium-to-heavy loads including CEILINGS — chandeliers, hanging fixtures, wall cabinets, cornices, heavy mirrors. For drywall, suspended ceilings, hollow brick/block, wood/composite panels.

MarketVerdictWhyBuyers
CanadaPRIMARY PRIMARY TARGET — commit first, hardest. USD ~1.4B drywall market growing ~6.6%/yr on record immigration-driven housing and ~USD2B/yr HS 7318 imports, and Turkey sits OUTSIDE Canada's 170% anti-dumping wall on Chinese/Taiwanese carbon-steel fasteners — a clean opening to displace them at low MFN duty. 77
Austria SELECTIVE — hard home turf. Steady duty-free DACH demand, but it is Knauf's home market, so local supply on these commodity anchors is entrenched and price-competitive. 12
Belgium GO — distribution node. Antwerp re-export gateway and a dense merchant network; duty-free access makes it valuable as a logistics/redistribution point more than for domestic volume. 29
Croatia Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 23
Czechia GO — CEE growth. Solid CEE construction and manufacturing base with duty-free Customs Union access and central-European distribution reach into neighboring markets. 19
Denmark SELECTIVE — niche. Small but high-spec building market with duty-free access; niche volumes and a longer northern haul limit scale. 30
Finland Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 24
France STRONG GO. Top-3 EU plasterboard market served by direct Turkey-to-France RoRo lines, duty-free under the Customs Union, with renovation/energy-retrofit demand lifting board volumes. 15
Germany TOP EU PRIORITY — beachhead of the bloc. Largest EU gypsum-board consumer/producer and the biggest 7318 import market, entering duty-free under the EU-Turkey Customs Union (A.TR) with 1-7 day truck/RoRo transit. 22
Greece Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 11
Hungary Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 23
Ireland GO — momentum pick. Acute housing shortage is driving one of Europe's fastest residential build-outs, with duty-free access and an English-language merchant channel easing entry. 37
Italy STRONG GO. Top-5 EU plasterboard consumer on one of the shortest freight lanes from Turkey — direct RoRo to Italian ports — and duty-free under the Customs Union. 48
Netherlands GO — gateway/redistribution play. Rotterdam makes it the EU import-and-redistribution hub; duty-free access makes it an ideal low-friction beachhead to feed the wider bloc even though domestic consumption is modest. 27
Norway Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 19
Poland STRONG GO — best CEE growth pick. Fastest-growing CEE construction market on EU cohesion funds, with a large fastener distribution/manufacturing base and duty-free Customs Union access. 56
Portugal SELECTIVE. Smaller but recovering construction market; duty-free access and short Mediterranean freight, but modest absolute volumes. 28
Romania STRONG GO — standout CEE grower. Construction surged ~21% in 2025 on EU-cofinanced projects, with duty-free Customs Union access and short Black Sea/RoRo freight from Turkey. 16
Slovakia Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 36
Spain GO. Top-5 EU gypsum-board consumer with construction recovering, duty-free Customs Union access and short Mediterranean freight from Turkish ports. 36
Sweden SELECTIVE GO. High per-capita drywall use in timber-frame housing and duty-free access, but longer freight and entrenched Nordic incumbents (Knauf/Gyproc) compress margins. 33
Switzerland NICHE. 0% tariff under the EFTA-Turkey FTA and high-value construction, but a small, premium market that is well supplied domestically. 36
United Kingdom STRONG GO. Top-4 European plasterboard consumer with deep builders'-merchant and DIY distribution, and 0% tariff on industrial goods under the 2021 UK-Turkey FTA. 39
AustraliaSUGGESTED OPPORTUNISTIC GO. Plasterboard ~USD0.9B (+7.8%/yr) and fasteners ~USD1.2B with only a low MFN tariff and no punitive AD on Turkish origin, but no Turkey FTA and ~20-30 day freight cap the upside. 34
IsraelSUGGESTED Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 33
KuwaitSUGGESTED Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 12
MexicoSUGGESTED AVOID — punitive tariffs. No Turkey FTA, and Mexico's Dec-2025 decree imposes up to 25-50% duties on non-FTA steel incl. HS 7318 — punitive on a thin-margin commodity fastener. 34
New ZealandSUGGESTED Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 40
QatarSUGGESTED Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 21
Saudi ArabiaSUGGESTED WATCH / SELECTIVE. World's largest construction pipeline (USD1T+ Vision 2030: NEOM, Red Sea, Diriyah) with relations normalized since 2022-23, but residual boycott friction and no GCC-Turkey FTA (~5% MFN) add political and price risk. 23
South AfricaSUGGESTED Target market Import-reliant construction-fixings market with a distributor/merchant layer. 43
United Arab EmiratesSUGGESTED STRONG GO — best non-EU/Canada bet. Turkiye-UAE CEPA (in force Sep 2023) gives near-immediate 0% on most tariff lines into a booming Gulf construction market, plus Jebel Ali re-export reach across the wider GCC/MENA and short Mediterranean freight. 43
United StatesSUGGESTED AVOID (for now) — tariff-blocked. Section 232 now hits steel fasteners (HS 7318) at a full 50% derivative duty on Turkish origin (effective Aug 18 2025), pricing Turkish anchors out of a massive market despite strong demand. 32
